correctness.rationale: All 29,616 maximal tubings are generated both by a generic rooted-component recursion and by independently labeled bipartite brooms; these sets coincide. The flip skeleton is exhaustively constructed by deleting one proper tube and pairing its exactly two completions, yielding 7-regularity and 103,656 edges. The 70 color-pattern orbits under S4 x S4 are proved exhaustive by explicit orbit-stabilizer counts summing to 29,616. Breadth-first search from every representative visits all 29,616 vertices; the exact computed eccentricity is 15 plus the pattern length for each of all 70 patterns. Each entry has an explicit farthest witness stored in the certificate. All checks use integer arithmetic and verified package-local source files. Hence the finite enumeration proves the eccentricity law and diameter 22, with no inference about larger K_{p,q}.

originality.rationale: Three directly relevant primary full texts were inspected, including the exact graph-tubing/rotation correspondence and current published diameter estimates. Cardinal--Pournin--Valencia-Pabon explicitly leave balanced complete bipartite diameters open; Gargantini--Pastine--Torres improve their bounds and solve K_{2,q} for q=3..8, not K_{4,4}. The exact K_{4,4} value 22 and per-vertex formula ecc=15+spine length are not supplied by any located theorem, bound, same-object table, or checked record. Exact claim and equivalent-terminology searches included maximal tubing flips, graph associahedron skeleton, rotation graph, search trees, and balanced biclique. Nonappearance is evidence of lack of found coverage, not a universal novelty certificate.
residual_risks: An unindexed or unpublished computational distance table might already contain K_{4,4} under an alternative rotation-graph name.
The full finite proof uses an executable exact checker; it is not replaced by a short closed-form all-pairs distance theorem.
The conclusion applies only to the one-skeleton of K_{4,4}, not all balanced complete bipartite associahedra.

value.rationale: The balanced complete-bipartite graph-associahedron diameter is a natural, explicitly posed open-parameter family in the primary literature; the inspected 2024 work improves bounds but gives no answer for K_{4,4}. This result gives the exact nontrivial dimension-seven instance with 29,616 vertices, not merely a toy single edge or normalization calculation. It further organizes every vertex by an intrinsic search-tree spine statistic and determines all four eccentricity classes and multiplicities, providing a complete finite structural classification and a reproducible benchmark for future general K_{p,q} diameter work.
